description: This file defines the AzureBlobStorageLogger class, which manages logging to Azure Blob Storage, including authentication, batch sending, and file operations using Azure SDK and HTTP requests.

classes.name: AzureBlobStorageLogger
classes.description: A logger class for batching and uploading logs to Azure Blob Storage, supporting both account key and Azure AD token authentication, with methods for batch processing and file management.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the logger, sets environment variables, and starts periodic flushing.

methods.name: async_log_success_event
methods.description: Logs a successful event asynchronously by appending to the log queue.

methods.name: async_log_failure_event
methods.description: Logs a failed event asynchronously by appending to the log queue.

methods.name: async_send_batch
methods.description: Sends all queued logs to Azure Blob Storage in batch.

methods.name: async_upload_payload_to_azure_blob_storage
methods.description: Uploads a single payload to Azure Blob Storage via a 3-step process.

methods.name: _create_file
methods.description: Creates a new file resource in Azure Blob Storage.

methods.name: _append_data
methods.description: Appends data to an existing Azure Blob file.

methods.name: _flush_data
methods.description: Flushes appended data to finalize the file.

methods.name: set_valid_azure_ad_token
methods.description: Refreshes the Azure AD token if expired or not set.

methods.name: get_azure_ad_token_from_azure_storage
methods.description: Retrieves an Azure AD token using environment variables and external utility.

methods.name: _azure_ad_token_is_expired
methods.description: Checks if the current Azure AD token is expired.

methods.name: _premium_user_check
methods.description: Verifies if the user has premium access, raises error if not.

methods.name: get_service_client
methods.description: Gets or creates an Azure Data Lake service client with caching.

methods.name: upload_to_azure_data_lake_with_azure_account_key
methods.description: Uploads payload to Azure Data Lake using SDK when account key is available.
